title: Hearty Lentil Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat and sauté onion, carrots, and celery for 5 minutes.
Add garlic, tomato paste, and smoked paprika; cook until fragrant (1 minute).
Stir in lentils, bay leaf, and broth. Bring to a boil, then simmer partially covered for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve with lemon wedges and crusty bread.
notes: Lentils thicken as they cool. Add more broth when reheating for a looser texture.

title: Citrus Herb Sheet-Pan Salmon
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss potatoes with 1 tbsp oil, salt, and pepper; roast 15 min.
Whisk remaining oil with lemon zest/juice, Dijon, honey, dill, and parsley.
Add asparagus and salmon to pan, brush with citrus herb glaze, top salmon with orange slices.
Roast 10–12 min more until salmon flakes easily and potatoes are tender.
notes: Swap asparagus for green beans in winter. Leftover glaze doubles as salad dressing.

title: Mango Chia Overnight Oats
instructions: Combine oats, almond milk, yogurt, chia seeds, maple syrup, and vanilla in a jar; stir well.
Fold in half the diced mango. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Top with remaining mango, toasted coconut, and lime zest before serving.
notes: For extra protein add a scoop of vanilla protein powder and an extra splash of milk.

title: Spicy Chickpea Stew
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onions and bell pepper; sauté for 5 minutes.
Stir in garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, and cayenne; cook until fragrant (1 minute).
Add chickpeas, diced tomatoes, and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with fresh parsley before serving.
notes: Can be served with rice or crusty bread.

title: Quinoa Tabbouleh Salad
instructions: In a pot, bring quinoa and water to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes. Let it cool.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled quinoa, tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, parsley, and mint.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
notes: Chill for 30 minutes for better flavor.

title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
instructions: In a saucepan, heat the vegetable broth; keep warm over low heat.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil and 1 tbsp butter over medium heat. Sauté onion and mushrooms until soft.
Stir in garlic, then add Arborio rice, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in white wine (if using); stir until absorbed. Gradually add broth, one ladle at a time, stirring constantly until absorbed before adding more.
Once creamy, stir in remaining butter and Parmesan cheese. Season with salt and pepper.
notes: For added flavor, sauté mushrooms separately and add them before serving.
